text.en:
Attachment. The DAP is hereby attached to the NEDA for policy
and program coordination.

Separability. If any part or provision of this Order shall be held
invalid, or unconstitutional, the provisions not affected thereby shall remain in full force

Repeal. All orders, rules and regulations, and other issuances or
parts thereof which are inconsistent with the provisions of this Order are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon publication
in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 25 *ay of October, in the year of our Lord,
Two Thousand and Twenty-Three.
By the President:
LUCAS P. BERSAMIN
Executive Secretary
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
